text:
emma: Heads-up — MidWest Bank wants a compact compliance bundle for the POC. They asked for: SOC2 excerpt, ISO 27001 scope summary, signed pen-test authorization letter, network diagram for the VPC/Dedicated setup, and explicit KMS key custody statement. Also asked whether Dedicated locks pricing for the POC. They want a 2-week turnaround. Looping @liam and @nitya to own artifacts.

liam: On it. Quick Q — do they need the full SOC2 report or just a control mapping + evidence pointers? I can turn around mapping faster.

emma: Customer said "SOC2 excerpt + evidence pointers" — not the full Type II report. They also want a pen-test letter signed by Redwood confirming authorization for their vendor to scan staging/Dedicated targets. They asked who signs (legal).

nitya: I can assemble SOC2 control mapping and ISO scope summary. For KMS custody we have two standard options: 1) Redwood-managed keys (AES-256, no export) or 2) Customer-managed BYOK (HSM-backed) for Private. I'll draft explicit wording.

chris: I can take the pen-test signatory. Need to review allowed test window, targets, and safe-words. Will need Legal approval but can get a minimal letter ready.

danielle: For infra: current POC staging is in Hosted and uses ephemeral IPs. If they want Dedicated/VPC we can provide a static CIDR and coordinate a controlled external scan. Network diagram + CIDR assigned: ~48 hrs after they confirm Dedicated vs Hosted. We can also support presigned SFTP for evidence transfer.

liam: Pricing note — Dedicated commits lock a monthly rate. We can offer a 60-day Dedicated POC trial with a reduced commit (commercial exception) or standard hosted pay-as-you-go. I'll run numbers with pricing ops if you want that option.

emma: They asked for a signed pen-test letter today if possible (they want to schedule next-week). Legal typically needs ~48 hrs. @chris can you expedite?

chris: Pushing now. Drafting minimal language — will post here. Snippet: ```
Redwood Inference authorizes [vendor name] to perform penetration testing against the following targets during [start date] — [end date]. Tests must be non-destructive, coordinated with Redwood SRE, and limited to explicitly listed IP/CIDR ranges. Any findings classified as critical must be escalated to Redwood security immediately for mitigation.````

infra-bot: NOTICE: Request logged — ticket INF-3472 created for network diagram and scan-window coordination.

nitya: I'll prepare the SOC2 control mapping doc and ISO scope summary. Expect first drafts by tomorrow EOD. Can someone confirm the exact artifact list the customer wants (policy excerpts, sample logs, vuln scan reports)?

emma: Customer replied (copied): "Prefer minimal artifacts: SOC2 control mapping + access control policy excerpt, network diagram, pen-test letter signed, KMS custody statement. POC will not require the full report." They also want pricing for a 90-day Dedicated POC and hosted rates.

liam: Understood. I'll sketch pricing and run with pricing ops. Tentative timeline: pen-letter (legal sign) by tomorrow, SOC+ISO mapping by tomorrow EOD, network diagram 48 hrs after Dedicated confirmation. I'll set a customer call for Friday to confirm scope.

chris: :thumbsup: pushing legal now. If you need tweaks to the pen-letter wording, ping me in thread.

emma: Thanks everyone — I'll update customer with the tentative timelines and schedule Friday call.
